Byte-exact generated PSD comparison:

Differential fixed-point test:
  200000 deterministic full-range input pairs.
  Q16 multiply, Q16 divide, Q24 multiply output stream: byte-identical.
  SHA-256: 16c823850373565bcb9ef23db37462a4f3566dcaa4347fb9cdd6f3e5f1573f0c

Differential PSD IEEE scalar conversion test:
  200000 deterministic finite patterns/values.
  Baseline vs fixed/integer implementation output stream: byte-identical.
  SHA-256: 32d3fcf307c23e21eea30126d2b52463f5c1588067eec92e1fef9b2b4f62f7b5

Forbidden native construct scan over src/include/tests/examples C/H:
  no malloc(...)
  no calloc(...)
  no realloc(...)
  no free(...)
  no native long long declarations/uses
  no native floating scalar declarations/uses
  no int64_t / uint64_t declarations/uses
  no unsigned long / signed long storage types in psd89 API/core

Note: PSD itself contains descriptor type names such as the literal string "long" and 8-byte wire fields. Those are format identifiers/payload widths, not native C scalar types. Eight-byte payloads are represented as two psd89_u32 halves.
